extracted_claims.text: As enacted in 2024, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (AI Act) provided that the obligations for high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III would apply 36 months after entry into force, i.e. from 2 August 2026.
The 'AI Omnibus' (Digital Omnibus on AI) amended Article 113 of the AI Act, postponing the application date for Annex III high-risk AI system obligations from 2 August 2026 to 2 December 2027.
The AI Omnibus was adopted on 19 November 2025, a political agreement between Council and Parliament was reached on 7 May 2026, and the amending Regulation entered into force on 27 July 2026.

The consolidated EUR-Lex text (version dated 27 July 2026) and the EU AI Act Service Desk confirm that, as amended, operators of high-risk AI systems placed on the market before 2 August 2026 remain subject to the Regulation only if subject to significant design changes after the 'date of application of Chapter III' referred to in Article 113.
Under the amended timeline, obligations for high-risk AI systems embedded in regulated products listed in Annex I will apply from 2 August 2028.

Several non-official sources published in September 2026 claim that the Annex III high-risk deadline was moved again, from 2 December 2027 to 2 August 2029, due to delays in harmonised standards and notified-body designation.
One of these sources states providers would not need conformity assessment by a notified body for Annex III systems until 2 August 2029.

Interpretive commentary notes that Annex III itself is a list of use-case categories that can be classified as high-risk, not a list of systems that are automatically high-risk, and that other obligations (Article 50 transparency, AI literacy, prohibitions) apply on separate, earlier timelines (2 August 2026 and 2 December 2026).

A news/legal commentary source described the 2 December 2027 and 2 August 2028 dates as 'backstop dates' contingent on the omnibus amendments being approved before 2 August 2026, warning that absent approval the original 2 August 2026 date would apply by default.

report:
# When Do Annex III High-Risk AI System Obligations Apply Under the EU AI Act?

## Executive Summary
As originally enacted, the EU AI Act set 2 August 2026 as the application date for high-risk AI system obligations under Annex III. However, the "AI Omnibus" amendment, which entered into force on 27 July 2026, postponed this deadline to **2 December 2027** (high confidence). Several non-official sources from September 2026 claim a further postponement to 2 August 2029; corroboration across three sources raises this claim's confidence score, but the lack of any official EU corroboration and the low authority of these sources means it should still be treated with significant caution.

## Key Findings

### Original Timeline (2024 Enactment)
As enacted in 2024, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 provided that Annex III high-risk AI system obligations would apply 36 months after entry into force, i.e. from 2 August 2026 (high confidence) ([European Parliament](https://www.europarl.europa.eu/topics/en/article/20230601STO93804/eu-ai-act-first-regulation-on-artificial-intelligence), [EU AI Act Implementation Timeline](https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/implementation-timeline), [Art. 113 AI Act](https://ai-act-law.eu/article/113)). Numerous secondary sources, including compliance guides and law firm analyses, reiterated this August 2026 date (high confidence) ([Goodwin Law](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/insights/publications/2024/10/insights-technology-aiml-eu-ai-act-implementation-timeline), [Squire Patton Boggs](https://www.squirepattonboggs.com/media/h3pcmbj2/ai-timeline-implementation-and-compliance.pdf)).

### The AI Omnibus Amendment
The "AI Omnibus" (Digital Omnibus on AI) amended Article 113 of the AI Act, postponing the application date for Annex III obligations from 2 August 2026 to **2 December 2027** (high confidence) ([EUR-Lex consolidated text](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML?uri=CELEX%3A02024R1689-20260727), [AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/article-111), [Digital Strategy — AI Omnibus enters into force](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/news/ai-omnibus-enters-force)). The legislative process is well-documented: the Omnibus was adopted on 19 November 2025, a political agreement between Council and Parliament was reached on 7 May 2026, and the amending Regulation entered into force on 27 July 2026 (high confidence) ([Council of the EU](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/05/07/artificial-intelligence-council-and-parliament-agree-to-simplify-and-streamline-rules), [Digital Strategy](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai)).

Under the amended framework, operators of high-risk AI systems placed on the market before 2 August 2026 remain subject to the Regulation only if subjected to significant design changes after the "date of application of Chapter III" (high confidence) ([EUR-Lex](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML?uri=CELEX%3A02024R1689-20260727), [AI Act Service Desk — Article 111](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/article-111)).

### Related Deadlines
Under the amended timeline, obligations for high-risk AI systems embedded in regulated products listed in Annex I (e.g., machinery, medical devices) will apply from **2 August 2028** (high confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk FAQ](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation), [Digital Strategy](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/faqs/navigating-ai-act)). Interpretive commentary clarifies that Annex III itself lists use-case *categories* that can be classified as high-risk, not a list of automatically high-risk systems, and that other obligations (Article 50 transparency rules, AI literacy requirements, prohibitions on certain practices) follow separate, earlier timelines of 2 August 2026 and 2 December 2026 (high confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk FAQ](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/faq), [Questa AI](https://www.questa-ai.com/privacy-cafe/eu-ai-act-countdown-is-your-annex-iii-system-ready-for-august-2026)).

### Disputed Further Postponement
Several non-official sources published in September 2026 claim the Annex III deadline was pushed again, from 2 December 2027 to **2 August 2029**, citing delays in harmonised standards and notified-body designation (high confidence based on corroboration across three independent sources, though all are of low individual authority and none is an official EU source) ([legal guide](https://eu-ai-act-legal-guide.example/2026/09/15/annex-iii-deadline-update), [AI law insights](https://ai-law-insights.example/2026/09/22/when-do-annex-iii-rules-apply), [tech legal alerts](https://tech-legal-alerts.example/2026-09-29-ai-act-high-risk-timeline)). One such source states providers would not need conformity assessment by a notified body for Annex III systems until 2 August 2029 (medium confidence, single-source corroboration only) ([AI law insights](https://ai-law-insights.example/2026/09/22/when-do-annex-iii-rules-apply)).

## Contradictions & Uncertainties
- **Outdated vs. current law**: Many sources still cite 2 August 2026 as the Annex III deadline; this reflects the pre-Omnibus text and is superseded by the amendment entering into force 27 July 2026 ([CSA research note](https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-eu-ai-act-high-risk-compliance-deadline-20) vs. [AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation)).
- **Disputed second postponement**: Official EU sources (EUR-Lex, Commission, Council) consistently state 2 December 2027 with no mention of further changes, while three non-official, non-authoritative sources claim a shift to 2 August 2029 ([Digital Strategy](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai) vs. [AI law insights](https://ai-law-insights.example/2026/09/22/when-do-annex-iii-rules-apply)). Despite multi-source corroboration raising this claim's confidence, the total absence of official backing means it should still be treated cautiously pending verification.
- A low-confidence source describes the 2 December 2027 and 2 August 2028 dates as conditional "backstop dates," contingent on the omnibus amendments being approved before 2 August 2026, warning that absent approval the original 2 August 2026 date would apply by default—though the Omnibus has since entered into force, likely mooting this concern ([LinkedIn/Oliver Patel](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/oliver-patel_when-will-eu-ai-act-high-risk-ai-compliance-activity-7401984085377830912-RglO)).

## Knowledge Gaps
- No official EU source confirms or denies the alleged 2 August 2029 postponement; the underlying legal instrument, if real, is unidentified, and it is unclear whether this represents a genuine legislative development, a misunderstanding, or inaccurate reporting.
- It is unclear whether the EUR-Lex consolidated text's reference to the "date of application of Chapter III" currently still points to 2 December 2027 or has been further amended, since the excerpted text does not explicitly restate the date ([EUR-Lex](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML?uri=CELEX%3A02024R1689-20260727)).
- It remains unresolved whether the 2 December 2027 and 2 August 2028 dates are final and binding or continue to be conditional "backstop dates" pending Commission confirmation that harmonised standards and conformity-assessment tools are available, as suggested by one low-confidence source ([LinkedIn/Oliver Patel](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/oliver-patel_when-will-eu-ai-act-high-risk-ai-compliance-activity-7401984085377830912-RglO)).
- It is unclear whether the 2 December 2027 date applies uniformly across all Annex III categories or varies by sub-category.

# When Do Annex III High-Risk AI System Obligations Apply Under the EU AI Act?

## Executive Summary
As originally enacted, the EU AI Act set 2 August 2026 as the application date for high-risk AI system obligations under Annex III. However, the "AI Omnibus" amendment, which entered into force on 27 July 2026, postponed this deadline to **2 December 2027** (high confidence). Unverified, non-official sources from September 2026 claim a further postponement to 2 August 2029, but this is not corroborated by any official EU source and should be treated with significant caution.

## Key Findings

### Original Timeline (2024 Enactment)
As enacted in 2024, Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 provided that Annex III high-risk AI system obligations would apply 36 months after entry into force, i.e. from 2 August 2026 (high confidence) ([European Parliament](https://www.europarl.europa.eu/topics/en/article/20230601STO93804/eu-ai-act-first-regulation-on-artificial-intelligence), [EU AI Act Implementation Timeline](https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/implementation-timeline), [Art. 113 AI Act](https://ai-act-law.eu/article/113)). Numerous secondary sources, including compliance guides and law firm analyses, reiterated this August 2026 date (high confidence) ([Goodwin Law](https://www.goodwinlaw.com/en/insights/publications/2024/10/insights-technology-aiml-eu-ai-act-implementation-timeline), [Squire Patton Boggs](https://www.squirepattonboggs.com/media/h3pcmbj2/ai-timeline-implementation-and-compliance.pdf)).

### The AI Omnibus Amendment
The "AI Omnibus" (Digital Omnibus on AI) amended Article 113 of the AI Act, postponing the application date for Annex III obligations from 2 August 2026 to **2 December 2027** (high confidence) ([EUR-Lex consolidated text](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML?uri=CELEX%3A02024R1689-20260727), [AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/article-111), [Digital Strategy — AI Omnibus enters into force](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/news/ai-omnibus-enters-force)). The legislative process is well-documented: the Omnibus was adopted on 19 November 2025, a political agreement between Council and Parliament was reached on 7 May 2026, and the amending Regulation entered into force on 27 July 2026 (high confidence) ([Council of the EU](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2026/05/07/artificial-intelligence-council-and-parliament-agree-to-simplify-and-streamline-rules), [Digital Strategy](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai)).

Under the amended framework, operators of high-risk AI systems placed on the market before 2 August 2026 remain subject to the Regulation only if subjected to significant design changes after the "date of application of Chapter III" (high confidence) ([EUR-Lex](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML?uri=CELEX%3A02024R1689-20260727), [AI Act Service Desk — Article 111](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/article-111)).

### Related Deadlines
Under the amended timeline, obligations for high-risk AI systems embedded in regulated products listed in Annex I (e.g., machinery, medical devices) will apply from **2 August 2028** (high confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk FAQ](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation), [Digital Strategy](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/faqs/navigating-ai-act)). Interpretive commentary clarifies that Annex III itself lists use-case *categories* that can be classified as high-risk, not a list of automatically high-risk systems, and that other obligations (Article 50 transparency rules, AI literacy requirements, prohibitions on certain practices) follow separate, earlier timelines of 2 August 2026 and 2 December 2026 (high confidence) ([AI Act Service Desk FAQ](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/faq), [Questa AI](https://www.questa-ai.com/privacy-cafe/eu-ai-act-countdown-is-your-annex-iii-system-ready-for-august-2026)).

### Disputed Further Postponement
Several non-official sources published in September 2026 claim the Annex III deadline was pushed again, from 2 December 2027 to **2 August 2029**, citing delays in harmonised standards and notified-body designation (medium confidence, corroborated across three sources but low individual source authority) ([legal guide](https://eu-ai-act-legal-guide.example/2026/09/15/annex-iii-deadline-update), [AI law insights](https://ai-law-insights.example/2026/09/22/when-do-annex-iii-rules-apply), [tech legal alerts](https://tech-legal-alerts.example/2026-09-29-ai-act-high-risk-timeline)). One such source states providers would not need conformity assessment by a notified body for Annex III systems until 2 August 2029 (medium confidence) ([AI law insights](https://ai-law-insights.example/2026/09/22/when-do-annex-iii-rules-apply)).

## Contradictions & Uncertainties
- **Outdated vs. current law**: Many sources still cite 2 August 2026 as the Annex III deadline; this reflects the pre-Omnibus text and is superseded by the amendment entering into force 27 July 2026 ([CSA research note](https://labs.cloudsecurityalliance.org/research/csa-research-note-eu-ai-act-high-risk-compliance-deadline-20) vs. [AI Act Service Desk](https://ai-act-service-desk.ec.europa.eu/en/ai-act/faq/when-does-ai-act-go-effect-what-its-timeline-implementation)).
- **Unverified second postponement**: Official EU sources (EUR-Lex, Commission, Council) consistently state 2 December 2027 with no mention of further changes, while three non-official, non-authoritative sources claim a shift to 2 August 2029 ([Digital Strategy](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai) vs. [AI law insights](https://ai-law-insights.example/2026/09/22/when-do-annex-iii-rules-apply)). This claim should be flagged as **low confidence** pending official corroboration.
- A low-confidence source describes the 2 December 2027 date as a conditional "backstop," suggesting the original 2 August 2026 date could apply by default absent formal approval—though the Omnibus has since entered into force, likely mooting this concern ([LinkedIn/Oliver Patel](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/oliver-patel_when-will-eu-ai-act-high-risk-ai-compliance-activity-7401984085377830912-RglO)).

## Knowledge Gaps
- No official EU source confirms or denies the alleged 2 August 2029 postponement; the underlying legal instrument, if real, is unidentified.
- It is unclear whether the 2 December 2027 date applies uniformly across all Annex III categories or varies by sub-category.
- Whether the 2 December 2027 date remains conditional on Commission confirmation of standards/tools availability is not fully resolved.
